note: T1144, ROADMAP D4. What each field of the truth set means, the rule that compares the shipped value with the verified answer (evals/run_truth.py compare()) and the tolerance. Tolerances follow the research in Execution/P15/T1144-truth-set.md.

country.means: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code of the country the place is in

coords.means: the centre of the town or city (its main square, old town or town hall), not the airport
coords.answer: lat, lon in decimal degrees, e.g. 52.0116, 4.3571

population.means: residents of the town or municipality the place is named after, latest census or estimate
population.where: Wikipedia infobox or the national statistics office

image_depicts.means: the cover photo shows this place (not another town, not a generic view)

blurb.means: the one-line blurb is supported by the cited Wikivoyage text (guide.url) or by well-known facts on the place's Wikipedia page

distance_km.means: length of the walk as Carta presents it (one way for a point to point, round for a loop)
distance_km.where: the OSM relation (distance tag) or the operator's page

ascent_m.where: the OSM relation (ascent tag) or the operator's page

loop.means: the walk ends where it starts
loop.where: the OSM relation (roundtrip tag) or its map

difficulty.means: Carta's grade: easy, moderate, hard, very_hard or alpine, as the operator or SAC scale would put it
difficulty.answer: one of easy, moderate, hard, very_hard, alpine
difficulty.where: operator page, sac_scale tag; see GUIDE.md for the mapping

trailhead.where: the OSM relation, the operator's page

summary.means: every claim of the summary is supported by the trail's source facts (OSM relation, its tags and map)

name.means: the beach's local name, accents ignored

water_quality.means: the latest EU bathing water class of the nearest monitored site (none when there is no site)
water_quality.answer: excellent, good, sufficient, poor or none

surface.means: what the beach is mostly made of
surface.answer: sand, pebble, gravel, rock, shingle, concrete

coords.means: a point on or at the lake (its centre is fine)

name.means: the lake's local name, accents ignored

water_quality.means: the latest EU bathing water class of a monitored site on the lake (none when there is no site)
water_quality.answer: excellent, good, sufficient, poor or none

swim.means: whether swimming is allowed and done (limited: only at some spots or some months)
swim.where: municipality or tourist board page, Wikipedia
